params.prompt: Logo design presentation on a plain warm off-white paper background (#F7F5F0), centered, flat vector logo only, no mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no extra words. Brand: JISOAR, a Korean independent software studio that turns what clients imagine into working systems, web services and apps. Name meaning: JI (志, will/intention) + SOAR. Colors: deep navy #101A33 primary, optional single accent sky blue #3366E8. Timeless, crafted, premium, like a logo by a top identity studio, not trendy, perfectly spelled JISOAR. Direction: refined custom sans-serif wordmark JISOAR with classic proportions and generous optical spacing; one subtle custom detail only: the J's descender extends in a long graceful horizontal stroke under the I like a foundation line. Navy only.
